dedupe_keys.name: dataset of potential tsunami scenarios in the south china sea

description: Dataset of Potential Tsunami Scenarios in the South China Sea is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Guangsheng Zhao et al. The South China Sea is surrounded by many large cities with developed economy and dense population along the coast, where tsunamis are major potential disasters within the sea area. Therefore, a dataset and assessment of potential tsunami scenarios are an important foundation for design of coastal and ocean engineering, disaster prevention and mitigation strategy. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: Excel, MATLAB, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 373090524 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
